_note: Simulator layout. Screen positions are canvas pixels (1920x1080), measured from the team's 1440p table recording at 1:1 scale; Recognition reads these. The camera was fitted to the same footage so the 3D table lines up with it; world units are cm, origin at the centre of the felt circle, +x to the viewer's right, +z towards the dealer.
_box_note: seats[n].box: the four corners of each printed seat box in the footage (canvas px), clockwise from the corner nearest the dealer on the left.

video._note: The full 16:9 video frame in layout units. The layout's 1920x1080 table crop sits inside it at (167, 246). Fitted from a screenshot of the live page (seat positions matched to within a few pixels).

page._note: Margins around the video on the live page (left sidebars, right sidebar, top, bottom bar), in CSS pixels. Override with ?inset=left,right,top,bottom.

_card_note: seats[n].card is the FIRST card's centre; each later card goes lower (towards the player) and slightly right, on top, as the dealers place them.
